pembrolizumab treatment was stopped because of a widespread morbilliform reaction
new widespread, asymptomatic skin eruption had been ongoing for 1 to 2 weeks

concepts.why: The patient has a history of chronic pulmonary coccidiomycosis and is being treated with fluconazole.
The patient had a previous widespread morbilliform reaction to pembrolizumab and now has a new skin eruption.
The patient has a low hemoglobin level of 8.2 g/dL.
The patient has a low platelet count of 62 ×103/μL.
The patient has atypical cells on skin biopsy and abnormal laboratory results.
The patient has a low white blood cell count, low platelet count, and anemia.
The patient has a widespread skin eruption and atypical cells on skin biopsy.
The patient has anemia and a history of autoimmune reaction.
